correctness.summary: Extreme-point rigidity gives the exact log-parameter equality relation. Any affine equivalence must preserve the common construction circle and hence is a Euclidean isometry preserving the two vertex-accumulation points, which yields the plus-or-minus phase classification. The area follows from central-angle gaps, reduces to a periodized hyperbolic secant, and matches the stated Fourier and Jacobi-dn expansions; dn monotonicity gives the unique endpoint extrema.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: Segal's 2026 preprint supplies the arbitrary-alpha family and translated-polar identity, but its current text does not state the affine-equivalence/moduli classification, any area formula, or the periodized-sech/Jacobi-dn structure. Related self-polar, self-nolar, and autopolar-cone literature uses different duality/equivalence settings. Searches did not locate an equivalent result, with residual risk from the recency of the motivating preprint.

value.summary: The result turns an existence construction into an exact one-dimensional affine-congruence moduli space and supplies a strict intrinsic coordinate on it. It proves uncountably many pairwise non-affinely-equivalent translated-self-polar bodies and identifies Segal's two selected examples as the unique area extrema, with a closed Fourier/Jacobi description of the entire area spectrum.

limitations: Only Segal's explicit planar alpha-family is classified; all solutions of K^circ = K - s are not classified.
No corresponding higher-dimensional volume-moduli theorem is claimed for the bodies of revolution.
No perturbative stability or rigidity result outside the explicit family is proved.
The polar area product statement is origin-based and is not a statement about the Santaló-minimized Mahler product.
The motivating preprint is very recent, leaving residual risk from a later revision or an unindexed parallel observation.
Independent audit has not been performed.
review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.
